description: Add scoped programmatic snapshots and Ctrl+Z restoration for manual creation and add/edit question forms while preserving native input and contentEditable undo.
steps: Create a bounded typed undo snapshot utility with record-before-change, restore, and clear/invalidate operations; add pure tests for complete card/manual state restoration and empty/bounded behavior.

Record snapshots before parser/converter applications, bulk replacements, text-rewriting type changes, accepted local-AI fallbacks, and manual draft state replacements in ManualQuizCreator.tsx and QuizQuestionFormModal.tsx.

Handle Ctrl+Z/Cmd+Z at the active form boundary only when a programmatic snapshot is pending and the event was not already default-prevented; otherwise allow native input or existing RichTextEditor document.execCommand undo.
Clear stale history on modal close, question load/change, draft reset, and restored state, then run focused tests, typecheck, build, and browser checks.
acceptance_criteria: After a parser/converter change in manual creation, Ctrl+Z restores the previous question text, target term/options, and relevant quiz term state.
After a parser/converter change in add or edit modal, Ctrl+Z restores the previous question text and answer/options/explanation as one card unit.
Native Ctrl+Z in ordinary inputs and RichTextEditor remains available, and unrelated controls are not intercepted by a document-wide listener.
Stale async SmolLM2 output cannot overwrite a user edit or an undo-restored state.
Undo helper tests, web typecheck, web build, and full Vitest pass.
verification: Browser Ctrl+Z checks in manual creation, add-question, and edit-question flows
findings: Implemented scoped programmatic undo without replacing native input/contentEditable undo. The manual history restores the quiz-level term and complete questions array; modal history restores the complete card including type, prompt, options, answer, enumeration fields, and explanation. Capture-phase form boundaries handle pending programmatic snapshots before RichTextEditor, while ordinary edits clear pending snapshots and retain native undo. No document-wide listener was added, and stale async local-AI results are invalidated by edits, paste applications, undo restoration, close, unmount, and question/open changes. The existing apps/web/hooks/useQuizSession.ts change was preserved untouched. Browser runtime checks were unavailable and remain needs verification during implementation/follow-up.
implementation_details: Added apps/web/lib/authoringUndo.ts with typed bounded snapshot history, deep snapshot cloning, recordBeforeProgrammaticChange, undoProgrammaticChange, clear, invalidate, and hasPendingSnapshot operations.
Added apps/web/lib/__tests__/authoringUndo.test.ts covering complete manual/card restoration, clone isolation, empty behavior, bounded history, clear, and invalidate.

ManualQuizCreator now records before clipboard card conversion, bulk import/cancel replacement, type transformations, accepted local-AI cards, and draft restoration; structural question changes and ordinary edits invalidate stale snapshots.

QuizQuestionFormModal now records before clipboard card conversion and type transformations, restores all card fields as one unit, clears on close/load and ordinary edits, and invalidates pending local-AI results on undo.
Added narrow data-marked undo targets for relevant bulk/draft/type controls while metadata and unrelated buttons remain outside the interception boundary.
